Bridal Glow — Makeup & Hair Artistry, Bengaluru

Bridal Glow is a Bengaluru bridal makeup studio specializing in South Indian
bridal looks, traditional silk-saree draping, and natural, skin-friendly
finishes for daytime ceremonies.

Their bridal package (muhurtham + reception) is ₹55,000, including draping and a
trial. Family and bridesmaid makeup is charged per person.

Contact: +91 80886 71140 · book@bridalglow.example
Location: Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka
Rating: 4.7 / 5 (152 reviews)
